content:
Up to now I've flattened the Ivy structures when I translate models to Lean4/Veil (veil-2.0-preview)

I'd like to use structure in Veil but I'm running into problems with all the invariants ending with a bang in the SMT part (except the Initialization part passes)

Is structure supported at this point?

The following is a MWE, please comment

import Veil

veil module struct

type proc
type data

enum msg_cmd     = {empty, reqs, reqe, inv, invack, gnts, gnte}

@[veil_decl]
structure noc_msg (msg_cmd : Type) (data : Type) where
  m_cmd  : msg_cmd
  m_data : data

function chan1    : proc → noc_msg msg_cmd data

#gen_state

after_init {
  chan1 P     := { (chan1 P) with m_cmd := empty}
}

action pc_req (p:proc) {
  chan1 p := { (chan1 p) with m_cmd := reqs}
}

invariant [chan1_valid_cmd]
(chan1 P).m_cmd = empty ∨ (chan1 P).m_cmd = reqs ∨ (chan1 P).m_cmd = reqe

#time #gen_spec

#check_invariants

end struct
Structures are not well supported at this point. We're planning to work on it in the near future, along with adding support for inductive types: #Veil > Inductive Types
For now, you should manually flatten structures.
